details.question: 白金卡客户与金卡客户的平均持仓市值差值
details.generated_sql:
WITH cust_hold AS (
    SELECT c.pty_id, c.cust_lvl_cd, COALESCE(SUM(h.mkt_val), 0) AS total_mkt_val
    FROM ads_cust_info_d c
    LEFT JOIN dwd_cust_hold_d h ON c.pty_id = h.pty_id AND h.data_dt = '20260331'
    WHERE c.data_dt = '20260531'
      AND c.cust_lvl_cd IN ('1000002', '1000003')
    GROUP BY c.pty_id, c.cust_lvl_cd
)
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN cust_lvl_cd = '1000002' THEN total_mkt_val END) -
    AVG(CASE WHEN cust_lvl_cd = '1000003' THEN total_mkt_val END) AS avg_mkt_val_diff
FROM cust_hold
details.standard_sql: with lvl_hold as (select d.describe as cust_lvl, avg(coalesce(h.total_mkt_val,0)) as avg_hold_val from ads_cust_info_d a left join (select pty_id, sum(mkt_val) as total_mkt_val from dwd_cust_hold_d where data_dt='20260331' group by pty_id) h on a.pty_id = h.pty_id left join dim_public d on a.cust_lvl_cd = d.code and d.code_type_id='100' where a.data_dt='20260531' group by d.describe) select (select avg_hold_val from lvl_hold where cust_lvl='紫金理财白金卡客户') - (select avg_hold_val from lvl_hold where cust_lvl='紫金理财金卡客户') as hold_diff
